<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<s:Envelope xmlns:s="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:u="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd">
	<s:Header>
		<o:Security s:mustUnderstand="1" xmlns:o="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd">
			<o:UsernameToken u:Id="uuid-b3ccf94f-1e40-4b24-bfef-76861020f70e-7">
				<o:Username>{{SenderID}}</o:Username>
				<o:Password Type="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-username-token-profile-1.0#PasswordText">{{Password}}</o:Password>
			</o:UsernameToken>
		</o:Security>
	</s:Header>
	<s:Body>
		<SendStreamRequest xmlns="http://CargoWise.com/eHub/2010/06">
			<Payload>
				<Message ApplicationCode="{{ApplicationCode}}" ClientID="{{RecipientID}}" TrackingID="{{$guid}}" SchemaName="{{SchemaName}}" SchemaType="Xml" EmailSubject="" FileName=""></Message>
			</Payload>
		</SendStreamRequest>
	</s:Body>
</s:Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<s:Envelope xmlns:s="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:u="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd">
	<s:Header>
		<o:Security s:mustUnderstand="1" xmlns:o="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd">
			<o:UsernameToken u:Id="uuid-b3ccf94f-1e40-4b24-bfef-76861020f70e-7">
				<o:Username>{{SenderID}}</o:Username>
				<o:Password Type="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-username-token-profile-1.0#PasswordText">{{Password}}</o:Password>
			</o:UsernameToken>
		</o:Security>
	</s:Header>
	<s:Body>
    <FinaliseBatch xmlns="http://CargoWise.com/eHub/2010/06">
      <trackingID>Tracking ID from RetrieveSteam response header</trackingID>
    </FinaliseBatch>
	</s:Body>
</s:Envelope>
